CustomField.description: Channel partner lock-in: for this many days after a channel partner submits a customer (normalised phone + project) that only channel partners have, a Direct Sales, Digital or other non-CP lead for that customer is refused. Blank: no lock-in.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Days after a channel partner submits a customer during which a non-CP lead for that customer and project is refused. Blank: no lock-in.
CustomField.label: CP Lock-in Days
